correct_existing_implementation: Single ordinary Adam per scaler iteration; full and shared step producers use unscale/step/update and scale comparison correctly under the actual source.
Shared full/partial backwards produce one optimizer_updated flag, not two updates.
Full-official smoke counts only optimizer_updated=true and requires three; the skipped RGB attempt was not counted.
Full-official train separately records attempts, optimizer_steps, skips, per-batch details and epoch cumulative totals.
Existing strict model-state reload and final active-gradient checks passed within their documented scope.
limitations: Finite loss does not imply finite gradients; the third attempt triggered non-finite detection. Its affected tensors and inf-versus-NaN origin are unrecorded.
Final gradients check covers only last backward; strict reload covers eight query outputs/model.state_dict, not optimizer/scaler or universal parameter/buffer finiteness.

Actual RGB training BatchNorm buffers update in forward before skip. RGB eval bypasses classification BN, so reload equality is not evidence that every BN buffer is healthy. No buffer corruption was demonstrated.
Fourth batch differs from third; successful scale256 does not prove the failed batch would succeed at256 or justify changing initial scale.
Full training starts fresh at512 and uses per-epoch seeds/scheduler; smoke recovery scale is not carried over.
Fixed50epochs means fixed scheduled batch attempts, not fixed successful optimizer updates; no automatic retry or budget compensation is recommended.
Existing visited/coverage includes skipped batches. Report it as forward coverage; derive successful-update record coverage from true rows if claiming effective update coverage.
Default8 parity does not establish candidate32 FP32 backward equivalence.
No head16/head32 formal performance exists yet; paper targets and same-checkpoint reporting remain unfulfilled.
